title: AquaTerra in October 2025: {count} drives, Diwali and art
description: AquaTerra's October 2025: {count} drives around Diwali, from Green Diwali posters and greeting cards for children to Disco Diwali 2.0, the festival fundraising night.
lede: In October 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, and most of them were tied to Diwali. Art workshops for children made greeting cards and Green Diwali posters, Disco Diwali 2.0 ran as a fundraising night at 60 Chowrangee Banquet, and a survey drive helped non-teaching staff at Ek Tara.

sections.heading: diwali cards and posters
body: Three art workshops in the middle of October were built around Diwali. The Art Nook at School On Wheels on 14 October made greeting cards, and Diwali stories were read aloud to the children. Mindful Marks at Amader Pradakhep on 15 October made Diwali greeting cards as well, and Color Club at Ek Tara on 17 October had the children make Green Diwali posters.

The posters came out of a lesson on why a green Diwali matters and how firecrackers harm the environment. It is a good example of a [children's art workshop](/impact/how-to-run-an-art-workshop-for-kids) that carries a message as well as a craft.

sections.heading: disco diwali 2.0
body: Disco Diwali 2.0 was held on 21 October at 60 Chowrangee Banquet. It had the largest team of the month, and the write-up calls it AquaTerra's biggest Diwali fundraising success. The write-up also says small businesses took part in the night.
Like our other fundraising nights, it helps pay for the welfare drives. The [fundraising page](/impact/fundraising) explains how the nights fit alongside the everyday work.

sections.heading: a survey drive at Ek Tara
body: Form assistance drive on 24 October was a different kind of day. The team helped non-teaching staff at Ek Tara with surveys, and the write-up says 30 non-teaching staff members were assisted. It is the month's closing drive, and it shows the work can be practical as well as creative.
Ek Tara also hosted Color Club on 17 October, so the place had two sessions in one month. The [Ek Tara page](/impact/ek-tara) covers the wider run of sessions there.

sections.heading: canvas and conversations at Pather Sathi
body: Canvas & Conversations at Pather Sathi opened the month on 11 October. It explored creativity through colour, texture and hands-on art-making, and it is the one art session of October that is not tied to Diwali.
Pather Sathi hosted only one session this month, so most of October's children's work happened at other places, including School On Wheels and Amader Pradakhep.

sections.heading: how october compares
body: September ran {count:month-2025-09} drives and December ran {count:month-2025-12}, so October was the shortest of the three, and most of it was built around one festival. The [December 2025 page](/impact/month-2025-12) picks up the Christmas sessions that followed.

learnings: A short month can still have a clear theme: most of October's drives were tied to Diwali.
Diwali work with children can carry a message. The Green Diwali posters came from a lesson on why firecrackers harm the environment.
Some art sessions run with a single volunteer turnout, so a small team can still run a complete workshop.
A fundraising night and a practical survey drive can share one month, which shows the work runs at very different scales.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in October 2025?
faqs.a: In October 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. Most were tied to Diwali, including greeting card and Green Diwali poster workshops for children. The month also had Disco Diwali 2.0, a fundraising night, and a survey drive at Ek Tara.

Disco Diwali 2.0 was AquaTerra's Diwali fundraising night, held on 21 October 2025 at 60 Chowrangee Banquet. The write-up calls it AquaTerra's biggest Diwali fundraising success, and the money raised goes to the welfare drives.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra run Diwali workshops for children in 2025?
faqs.a: Yes. In October 2025 children made Diwali greeting cards at School On Wheels on 14 October and at Amader Pradakhep on 15 October, and made Green Diwali posters at Ek Tara on 17 October.

faqs.q: How can I help with an AquaTerra art workshop for children?
faqs.a: Join AquaTerra with a Google sign-in, and a member of the team approves your account. AquaTerra is for students aged 14 to 19, and the children's workshops are planned and run by students. The how-to guide for an art workshop shows the steps.
